verdict.rationale: Dagster docs mention a feature for 'wiping and deleting dynamic partitions in a single action,' which gives some control over deleting specific partition data, but there is no documentation of broader data-retention policies (e.g., run history/log retention, PII deletion, GDPR controls) that an AI-native user could configure. missing for 10: retention policy configuration for run/event logs, documented data-deletion/export workflows, compliance-oriented retention settings, independent corroboration of these controls in practice.
